check: same-lead hourly persistence vs model forecasts, Vail 842 only; RETROSPECTIVE symmetric benchmark (anchors unavailable at issue time), NOT an operational selector and NOT an upper bound on operational persistence skill
correction_2026-11-26_pm: supersedes the numbers first committed in 4ebb1b1: the initial version of this script computed anchors with date-minus-timedelta(hours) arithmetic, which drops sub-day offsets (8h anchor landed 16h AFTER the valid instant - look-ahead - and 32h at valid-24h). Anchors are now computed with explicit UTC datetimes: valid D 08:00 UTC minus lead, converted to the verified UTC-8 CSV clock. Model scores also shifted slightly because the common-date intersection changed with anchor availability.

anchor_availability.available_at_init: NO - the same-lead construction puts the anchor exactly AT the init instant (anchor = valid - lead = init), and an observation is not transmitted before it exists. In the pulls sampled on 2026-11-26 (these stations, these dates), archive availability lagged >38h for hourly values, <32h for daily SNOTEL values, and >35h for one COOP daily value - sampled observations, not universal latency guarantees.
anchor_availability.why_symmetric: the anchor sits lead-hours before the valid instant, the same horizon the model forecast covers. This benchmark uses observations unavailable at issue time, so it is RETROSPECTIVE only.
what_it_does_not_show: it is NOT an upper bound on operational persistence skill: a more recent anchor does not guarantee smaller realized error, and a delayed operational anchor can do better on some samples

models losing to this benchmark does NOT establish that they lose to an operational delayed-anchor persistence; that comparison favors this benchmark and is tested separately in hourly_persistence_snotel_2026-11-26.json (delayed-anchor sensitivity)

lead_8h.contrast_note: daily persistence is anchored on the prior daily actual (zero-lag); hourly persistence is anchored lead-hours before the valid instant - the honest same-lead benchmark
